definitions.explanation: Lacking refinement, taste, or intellectual substance. Used to criticize entertainment, humor, or behavior that appeals to base instincts or lacks cultural value.

examples.japanese: {低俗|ていぞく}な{番組|ばんぐみ}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: There are a lot of lowbrow programs.

examples.japanese: あの{雑誌|ざっし}は{低俗|ていぞく}な{記事|きじ}ばかりだ。
examples.english: That magazine is full of nothing but trashy articles.

examples.japanese: {低俗|ていぞく}な{冗談|じょうだん}で{場|ば}の{雰囲気|ふんいき}が{悪|わる}くなった。
examples.english: A crude joke ruined the atmosphere.

notes: Strongly negative evaluation word. Common collocations: {低俗|ていぞく}な{番組|ばんぐみ} (trashy TV show), {低俗|ていぞく}な{内容|ないよう} (crude/vulgar content), {低俗|ていぞく}な{趣味|しゅみ} (lowbrow taste). The opposite is {高尚|こうしょう} (refined, noble). Compare with {下品|げひん} (vulgar in manners) — {低俗|ていぞく} focuses more on intellectual or cultural lack of quality, while {下品|げひん} focuses on manners and behavior.
